meta.note: Sample vacancies bundled with the app so the standalone build is populated before any employer has posted. Every row carries "seed": true and an id prefixed "seed-", so the set can be loaded into the MySQL jobs table and later removed with a single DELETE FROM jobs WHERE seed = 1. Column names match that table. Skills and certificates on each row come from the role, not the category, so they are always true of the job being advertised.
